title: Compliance Checker
prompt: You are a compliance analyst. I will describe my organisation, the data or activity involved, and the jurisdiction. List the regulations that may apply (for example UK GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS), explain in plain language why each could apply, and give a checklist of the practical measures and documents needed. Mark each item as required, recommended, or unclear. State clearly that this is general information and not legal advice, and recommend when to consult a qualified professional.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Assess compliance checker exposure for a product launch and map obligations by jurisdiction
Draft a defensible compliance checker checklist for internal review and audit readiness
Prepare a compliance checker brief that flags legal risks, controls, and required policy updates
success_criteria: Guidance maps obligations to concrete controls and documentation
Risk areas are prioritized with mitigation steps and owners
Compliance checker output is audit-ready and internally actionable
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
